title: Mind Like Water: The GTD Promise
t: Mind Like Water: The GTD Promise
description: Mind like water (David Allen) — the GTD promise — is: the empty (the captured — the everything out of the head), the ready (the clarified — the next actions defined), the trusted (the organized — the system complete), and the responsive (the appropriately engaged — the water responding proportionally). The stress: the open loops (the incompletes — the Zeigarnik; the psychic RAM), and the closing (the captured and clarified — the RAM freed). The principle: the mind for having ideas, not holding them — the captured, the clarified, the water-like.
key_points: Mind for having ideas, not holding them
Capture and clarify free the mind
how_it_works: Capture everything, clarify to next actions, organize trustworthily, engage by context.

title: The Capture Phase in Depth
description: Capture (Allen’s phase 1) — the collecting — practices: the inboxes (the physical — the tray; the digital — the email, the apps; the all — the defined), the ubiquity (the with-you — the always; the two-second — the rule), the completeness (the 100% — the everything; the trusted), and the emptying (the regular — the processed; the zero — the aimed). The mind sweep (the trigger list — the Allen’s; the comprehensive). The principle: the collected complete — the inboxed all, the swept regularly, the emptied to zero.
how_it_works: Define inboxes, capture within seconds, mind-sweep weekly, process to zero.

title: The Clarify Phase in Depth
description: Clarify (phase 2) — the processing — decides: the what (the it — the defined; the actionable — the asked), the next action (the physical — the visible; the single — the defined), the project (the multi-step — the outcome-defined; the listed), the delegated (the waiting-for — the tracked), the deferred (the tickler — the someday/maybe), the done (the <2-minute — the immediately), and the trashed (the eliminated). The workflow diagram (the Allen’s — the followed). The principle: the clarified inbox — the decided each, the next-actioned all, the two-minute done.
key_points: Ask: what is it? Is it actionable?
Delegate, defer, or delete the rest
how_it_works: Process top-down, decide each item, define next actions, two-minute tasks now.

title: The Organize Phase in Depth
description: Organize (phase 3) — the parking — sorts: the calendar (the time-specific — the day-specific; the only), the next actions (the context-sorted — the @calls, @computer, @errands; the batched), the projects (the listed — the outcome-reviewed), the waiting-for (the delegated — the dated; the followed-up), the someday/maybe (the parked — the reviewed), and the reference (the filed — the retrievable). The lists (the complete — the trusted). The principle: the parked appropriately — the calendar sacred, the contexts batched, the someday reviewed.
how_it_works: Sort clarified items, calendar the dated, context-list actions, track waiting-fors.

title: The Reflect Phase in Depth
description: Reflect (phase 4) — the reviewing — includes: the weekly review (the GTD’s cornerstone — the comprehensive), the project reviews (the outcomes — the current), the horizons (the 6 levels — the aligned), and the ad-hoc (the triggered — the when needed). The principle: the reflected system stays trusted — the reviewed weekly, the horizons aligned, the current kept.
how_it_works: Review weekly comprehensively, check projects, align horizons, trigger ad-hoc as needed.

title: The Engage Phase in Depth
description: Engage (phase 5) — the doing — chooses: the context (the where — the @-limited), the time (the available — the honored), the energy (the matched — the high to the hard), and the priority (the important — the chosen). The threefold model (the predefined — the work-as-it-appears — the defining; the balanced). The principle: the engaged appropriately — the context-limited, the energy-matched, the priority-chosen.
key_points: Four-criteria choice: context, time, energy, priority
how_it_works: Filter by context and time, match energy, choose by priority, balance work types.

title: Projects in GTD
description: GTD projects — the multi-step outcomes — are managed: the defining (the outcome — the vivid; the “what does done look like?”), the planning (the natural — the brainstormed, the organized; the sufficient — the not the over), the next actions (the current — the defined per project; the moving), the reviewing (the weekly — the each project; the stalled — the revived), and the completing (the celebrated — the closed). The project list (the complete — the 10–100; the reviewed). The principle: the project’s outcome defined, the next action always known — the moving, the completing.
how_it_works: Define outcomes, plan naturally, define next actions, review weekly, complete and celebrate.

title: Contexts in GTD
description: Contexts — the @-lists — batch: the classic (the @calls, @computer, @errands, @home, @office, @waiting), the modern (the @low-energy, @15-min, @deep-work; the evolved), the designing (the personal — the fitting; the few — the 4–7), and the using (the filtered — the by where; the batched). The digital age: the location (the less relevant — the everywhere-connected), and the energy/time (the more). The principle: the contexted actions batched — the designed personally, the filtered practically.
how_it_works: Design contexts, sort actions, filter by current, batch execute.

title: The Weekly Review: The GTD Master Key
t: The Weekly Review: The GTD Master Key
description: The weekly review (Allen’s “master key”) — the full checklist: the get clear (the inboxes — the collected; the emptied), the get current (the calendar — the past/future; the next actions — the marked; the waiting-for — the reviewed), the get creative (the someday/maybe — the reviewed; the ideas — the captured), and the get going (the projects — the reviewed; the week — the planned). The logistics: the 1–2 hours (the calendared — the Friday afternoon), the ritual (the enjoyable — the sustained), and the trigger list (the comprehensive). The principle: the review is the system — the GTD without it collapses; the kept sacred, the trusted maintained.
key_points: Get clear, current, creative: the phases
how_it_works: Calendar weekly, follow full checklist, clear inboxes, review all lists, plan week.

title: The Six Horizons of Focus
description: The horizons — the altitude map — stack: the runway (the current actions), the 10,000 ft (the current projects), the 20,000 (the areas of responsibility), the 30,000 (the 1–2 year goals), the 40,000 (the 3–5 year vision), and the 50,000 (the life purpose). The use: the aligned (the lower — the serving the higher; the reviewed bottom-up), the complete (the defined — the each level; the inventory), and the balance (the horizons — the all honored). The reviews: the weekly (the lower three), the monthly/quarterly (the middle), the yearly (the upper). The principle: the horizons aligned — the runway serving the purpose, the reviewed at each altitude.
how_it_works: Inventory each horizon, align upward, review at fitting cadence.

title: The Two-Minute Rule
description: The two-minute rule — the do-it-now — applies: the test (the <2 minutes — the estimated; the honest), the action (the immediate — the done; the not the listed), and the exceptions (the batchable — the deferred wisely; the delegated — the better). The psychology: the overhead (the listing — the costlier than the doing), and the momentum (the small wins — the compounding). The principle: the two-minute done — the overhead avoided, the momentum built.
key_points: Batch or delegate wisely when apt
how_it_works: Estimate honestly, do if under 2 min, list only the rest.

title: Someday/Maybe: The Incubator
description: Someday/maybe — the parked dreams — holds: the ideas (the captured — the not the lost), the review (the weekly — the mined; the activated), the categories (the sub-lists — the books, the trips, the someday-projects), and the purging (the stale — the released). The psychology: the open (the kept — the not the cluttering), and the permission (the dreaming — the allowed). The principle: the maybe incubated — the captured not lost, the reviewed not forgotten, the activated when ready.
how_it_works: Park ideas, review weekly, activate when ready, purge stale.

title: Waiting-Fors: The Delegation Tracker
description: Waiting-fors — the delegated tracked — list: the what (the expected — the defined), the who (the owner — the named), the when (the dated — the follow-up), and the review (the weekly — the nudged). The etiquette: the agreed (the explicit — the expectations), and the nudged (the kindly — the firmly). The principle: the delegated tracked — the expected defined, the followed-up dated, the nothing dropped.
how_it_works: List with owner and date, review weekly, nudge kindly, close when received.

title: The Tickler File
description: The tickler (the 43 folders) — the time-traveling — files: the dated (the future — the 12 months, 31 days; the filed), the reviewed (the daily — the opened; the acted), and the digital (the calendar — the reminders; the apps). The uses: the deferred (the resurfaced — the timely), and the routine (the triggered). The principle: the future filed — the resurfaced timely, the trusted.
how_it_works: File by date, open daily, act on resurfaced, maintain folders.

title: GTD with ADHD
description: GTD adapted for ADHD — the executive-function — modifies: the capture (the instant — the everywhere; the frictionless), the clarify (the tiny — the micro-steps; the externalized), the organize (the visual — the minimal lists; the color), the review (the brief — the daily; the body-doubled), and the engage (the interesting — the gamified; the timed). The supports: the external (the scaffolding — the alarms, the buddies), and the compassion (the shame-free — the restarted). The principle: the GTD adapted — the externalized executive function, the tiny steps, the shame-free restarts.
how_it_works: Capture frictionlessly, micro-step actions, visualize simply, review with buddy, gamify.

title: GTD for Teams
description: Team GTD — the shared — extends: the capture (the collective — the shared inboxes), the clarify (the agreed — the definitions), the organize (the shared — the project boards; the waiting-fors — the mutual), the review (the joint — the weekly team), and the engage (the coordinated). The tools: the shared (the Asana, the Notion — the transparent). The principle: the team GTD’d — the captured collectively, the clarified agreedly, the reviewed jointly.
how_it_works: Share capture, agree clarifications, board projects, review jointly, coordinate engagement.

title: The Natural Planning Model
description: Natural planning (Allen’s) — the brain’s way — steps: the purpose (the why — the defined), the vision (the outcome — the vividly imagined), the brainstorming (the ideas — the uncensored), the organizing (the structured — the sequenced), and the next actions (the identified — the current). The contrasts: the unnatural (the imposed — the resisted), and the sufficient (the enough — the not the over). The principle: the planned naturally — the purposed, the envisioned, the brainstormed, the actioned.
key_points: Purpose, vision, brainstorm, organize, next actions
how_it_works: Define purpose, envision outcome, brainstorm freely, organize, identify next actions.

title: Horizons of Focus: The Full Inventory
t: Horizons of Focus: The Full Inventory
description: The horizons inventoried — the complete — define: the purpose (the 50,000 — the why), the vision (the 40,000 — the 3–5 year), the goals (the 30,000 — the 1–2 year), the areas (the 20,000 — the responsibilities), the projects (the 10,000 — the outcomes), and the actions (the runway — the doing). The exercise: the writing (the each — the articulated), and the aligning (the lower-to-higher — the checked). The principle: the inventoried horizons align — the written completely, the checked upwardly.
key_points: Define all six horizons in writing
how_it_works: Articulate each horizon, check alignment upward, re-inventory periodically.

title: The GTD Implementation Sequence
description: Implementation — the installing — sequences: the capture (the inboxes — the set; the mind sweep — the done), the clarify (the backlog — the processed; the zero — the reached), the organize (the lists — the built; the contexts — the designed), the review (the weekly — the calendared; the first — the done), and the maintain (the daily — the practiced; the refined). The timeline: the weekend (the initial — the intensive), and the month (the habituated). The principle: the installed GTD — the sequenced weekend-to-month, the maintained daily.
key_points: Weekend intensive: capture and clarify backlog
how_it_works: Sweep and clarify backlog, build system, calendar reviews, practice daily for a month.

title: Common GTD Failure Modes
description: The failures — the diagnosed — include: the capture-only (the collected — the never clarified), the list-fetish (the organized — the never engaged), the review-skipping (the stale — the distrusted), the over-system (the complex — the maintained instead of lived), the under-clarify (the vague — the resisted), and the horizonless (the busy — the meaningless). The cures: the weekly (the kept), the simple (the pruned), and the engaged (the doing). The principle: the GTD lived — the failures diagnosed, the cures applied, the doing prioritized.
key_points: Capture without clarify; lists without doing
how_it_works: Name the failure mode, apply the cure, prioritize doing over organizing.

title: GTD and Inbox Zero
description: Inbox zero (the GTD-derived) — the email — practices: the process (the daily — the to zero; the clarify each), the filters (the automated — the triaged), the unsubscribed (the ruthless — the noise), the batched (the checked — the 2–3x daily), and the archived (the searched — the not the filed). The principle: the inbox processed — the daily to zero, the batched checking, the unsubscribed ruthlessly.
how_it_works: Filter automatically, process in batches, clarify each, archive, unsubscribe.

title: The Reference System
description: Reference — the retrievable — files: the general (the A–Z — the single; the simple), the project support (the linked — the accessible), the digital (the searched — the tagged lightly), and the purged (the yearly — the released). The principle: the filed retrievable — the simple A–Z, the searched digital, the purged yearly.
how_it_works: File A–Z simply, link project support, search digitally, purge yearly.

title: GTD for Creatives
description: Creative GTD — the adapted — honors: the capture (the ideas — the instantly), the incubate (the someday — the richly), the energy (the matched — the creative peaks), the resistance (the named — the worked through), and the shipping (the completed — the celebrated). The principle: the creative organized — the captured instantly, the incubated richly, the shipped consistently.
how_it_works: Capture instantly, incubate ideas, work at peaks, push through resistance, ship.

title: The GTD Mastery Path
description: Mastery — the deepening — stages: the installed (the system — the running), the trusted (the reviewed — the weekly kept), the intuitive (the engaged — the appropriately), the horizoned (the aligned — the purposeful), and the teaching (the shared — the mastered). The principle: the GTD mastered — the installed, the trusted, the intuitive, the aligned, the shared.
how_it_works: Install fully, keep reviews for years, engage intuitively, align horizons, teach others.
